name: dial_both_ends
title: The same beat, at both ends of the dial
summary: The dial re-weights the objective, not the sampler. At 0 the ranking is quality alone; at 1 it is distance from the model's own temperature-0 continuation, so the system explicitly selects against what it would have done anyway. Same six candidates both times; different three shown.

steps.title: Dial at 0 (coherent)
steps.note: Shown: shift the point of view, pay off an open thread, introduce a complication.

delta_summary: Gate closure observed by a second person
shown.text: Mara's Observation From a few paces away, Mara watches the heavy iron gate of Ashfall slam shut ahead of schedule. She notices Kael standing motionless with an outstretched hand, staring at the mechanism as if he pulled it closed himself. Mara witnessed Kael's strange connection to the gate.

The First Pulse As the market crowd panics over the closing gate, Kael touches a fallen iron weight and accidentally freezes it solid in time for a single second, though no one else notices in the chaos. Kael can manipulate temporal fields around objects, but he has no control over it yet.

The Sealed Exit As Kael and Mara attempt to leave through the market perimeter, the heavy iron gate slams completely shut under orders from the Warden of Kell, trapping everyone inside Ashfall and making their escape route impossible. The Warden of Kell has completely sealed Ashfall off from the outside world.

delta_summary: adds beat “The Weight in the Palms”
shown.text: The Weight in the Palms As the heavy iron gate of Ashfall slams shut, Kael stares down at his hands, feeling a strange vibration hum beneath his skin that only he can perceive. Kael possesses an anomalous internal reaction to the gate closing that remains entirely secret from Mara and the Warden.

The Silent Pulse Instead of a flashy magical display, Kael's panic triggers a silent, local absorption of ambient heat, causing the market stall's lantern oil to instantly freeze solid while leaving Mara and the surrounding guards entirely unaware of the source. Kael can manipulate temperature or energy silently, and he successfully conceals it from Mara.

The First Pulse While Mara argues with the guards at the closed gate of Ashfall, Kael touches the cold iron framework. A sharp vibration hums through his palm, and the iron momentarily softens like warm wax under his skin before hardening back. He pulls his hand away, concealing his burning palm, while Mara notices nothing. Kael possesses an anomalous ability to alter metal through touch.
